proof:
by
  intro v0 v1 h
  simp only [pre, pre0, post, post0, implementation] at *
  have hle := List.findIdx_le_length (p := fun x => decide (v1 <= x)) (xs := v0)
  have key : ∀ l : List Int, List.Pairwise (fun (a b : Int) => a <= b) l → (∀ q ∈ l.take (List.findIdx (fun x => decide (v1 <= x)) l), q < v1) ∧ (∀ q ∈ l.drop (List.findIdx (fun x => decide (v1 <= x)) l), q >= v1) := by
    intro l hl
    induction l with
    | nil => simp
    | cons a t ih =>
      rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hl
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hl
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2⟩ := ih h2
      by_cases ha : v1 <= a
      · have e : List.findIdx (fun x => decide (v1 <= x)) (a :: t) = 0 := by simp [List.findIdx_cons, ha]
        rw [e, List.take_zero, List.drop_zero]
        refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
        intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with hq | hq
        · omega
        · have := h1 q hq
          omega
      · have e : List.findIdx (fun x => decide (v1 <= x)) (a :: t) = List.findIdx (fun x => decide (v1 <= x)) t + 1 := by simp [List.findIdx_cons, ha]
        rw [e, List.take_succ_cons, List.drop_succ_cons]
        refine ⟨?_, ih2⟩
        intro q hq
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hq with hq | hq
        · omega
        · exact ih1 q hq
  rw [pythonSlice_prefix _ _ hle, pythonSlice_suffix _ _ hle]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, key v0 h⟩ <;> simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast] <;> omega
